name: A demo scenario carries to the EES check with the same numbers

planSteps.description: Navigate to /?scenario=near-limit (a demo history: 2026-05-01 to 2026-06-15 and 2026-08-20 to 2026-09-30, read on 2026-10-19; the banner data-testid=scenario-banner is shown)
Days used (data-testid=days-used) shows 88 and days left (data-testid=days-left) shows 2
Click 'EES check' in the top navigation (data-testid=nav-ees). Do not type a URL
The EES page also shows the demo scenario banner (data-testid=scenario-banner)
Enter 90 in the EES days used field (data-testid=ees-days-used) and click compare (data-testid=ees-compare)
The figure gap (data-testid=ees-figure-gap) says the counts are 2 days apart and the EES counts more
